topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe it! Of all the teachers, why does it have to be him? I mean, I've got all these memories, and none of them are exactly... they’re not the kind you want to come back to, you know? And now my kid’s going to be in the same class? It’s just... overwhelming. I just can't shake the feeling that it’s going to affect him, in all the wrong ways. What if he ends up feeling the same way I did? I need to figure out what to do, like, right now. Maybe I can talk to the principal, or something. I just need to protect my little one, you know? I can’t let history repeat itself.
